metadata.title: Vibrant Pop Portrait with Textured Overlays

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, high-key portrait of a female figure wearing a lime green textured coat against a distressed teal background, featuring thin pink illustrative outlines and minimalist geometric typography in the upper corners.
coreVisualRelationships: Complementary contrast between the lime green subject and the teal background
Juxtaposition of soft, voluminous fur texture against a gritty, scratched background surface
Thin magenta/pink accent lines tracing the silhouette to create a hand-drawn pop-art effect
Symmetrical typographic placement balancing the top left and top right corners
coreInvariants: Lime green or chartreuse primary garment
Distressed/grunge texture overlay across the entire canvas

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium-close-up shot, subject occupies approximately 60% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and expressive eyes, framed by voluminous blonde hair.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the central face, moves down through the texture of the coat, then outward to the corner typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample teal space in the upper third and sides, providing room for text and texture visibility.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all primary hues with a bright, high-key exposure on the subject's face.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid muddy browns or deep blacks

composition.position: top left and top right corners

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family usage with varying alignment to create balance.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic geometric proportions and sharp terminals.
Modern, clean, and highly legible in uppercase.
Open counters and geometric structure similar to the source.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key portrait of a blonde woman in a lime green faux fur coat, centered against a vibrant teal background. Apply a heavy scratched/grunge texture overlay and thin magenta hand-drawn outlines around her silhouette.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase geometric sans-serif text in the top corners using a pale yellow color. Use wide tracking and align the text to the outer margins.

verificationChecks: Is the background a saturated teal?
Is the coat a bright lime green?
Is the text geometric and widely spaced?
Are the magenta outlines present but subtle?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of the teal background
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist
Exact wording of the title and name
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not overlap the subject's head.
Check that the grunge texture doesn't obscure the subject's eyes.
Verify the magenta lines follow the silhouette accurately.
Confirm the teal and green colors pop against each other.
recipe.reuseFormula: Pop Portrait = (Centered Subject + High-Saturation Complementary Colors) + (Grunge Texture Overlay + Neon Outlines) + (Corner-Aligned Geometric Sans)
